mission: Provide age-appropriate, evidence-grounded, accessible learning experiences from early childhood through adult and professional education.

assessment.mastery: Require repeated success, novel variants, transfer, and regression evidence.

simulation_rule: Any curriculum objective may be represented as an original interactive simulation when the learning objective benefits from experiential practice.
independence: Use free/local/open resources first and convert repeated external-model assistance into reusable Buddy capabilities and regression tests.
copyright: Use licensed, public-domain, open, or authorized material and create original educational experiences rather than reproducing protected works.
